ai_summary: Asian Star Company Limited announced the resignation of Mr. Bijayananda Pattanayak, an Independent Director and member of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, effective September 8, 2026. The company states his resignation is due to "other professional commitments," with both the company and director confirming no other material reasons for his departure. This necessitates prompt board reconstitution to maintain regulatory compliance for independent directorships and committee memberships, though no immediate red flags regarding corporate governance issues are indicated by the provided reason.
